description: Land Acquisition - Weralugampola, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District - Radawana, Dompe D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing multiple parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed descriptions of the lands, their locations, claimants, and compensation procedures, which falls squarely under the "Land Gazettes" category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
